Interprets the MOFA factors fitted in 04. Each factor is a pattern of variation
shared across views; factors that explain embedding variance are
image-molecular axes.

Inputs: `mofa/*.hdf5` (04), `meta_corrected_by_cancer.rds` (02),
`gsva_scores_by_cancer.rds`, `surv_all.rds`, `clin_vars_by_cancer.rds` (03)

Outputs: figures in `figures/`, tables in `tables/`, `mofa_results.rds`

| Output | Question answered |
|---|---|
| Figure 5.1 | Which factors are shared between the image and molecular data? |
| Figure 5.2 | Which factors predict survival, with and without clinical adjustment? |
| Figure 5.3 | Which biological pathways does each factor reflect? |
| Table 5.1 | Integrated interpretation of image-associated factors |
| Table S5.1 | Full Cox results for every factor |
| Figure S5.1 | Kaplan-Meier curves for the top factor per cancer (descriptive) |
| Figure S5.2, Table S5.2 | Does batch correction carry through to the factors? |
| Figure S5.3 | Do factors track stage, grade or age? |
| Figure S5.4 | Which embedding dimensions drive each factor? |
| Figure S5.5 | GSEA on RNA weights, an independent pathway check |

# Setup

```{r libraries}
#| output: false
library(MOFA2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(broom)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(gt)
library(writexl)
```

```{r load}
data_dir <- "data"
mofa_dir <- "mofa"
fig_dir  <- "figures"
tab_dir  <- "tables"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(tab_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

meta_corrected_by_cancer <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "meta_corrected_by_cancer.rds"))  # 02: site, survival
gsva_scores_by_cancer    <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "gsva_scores_by_cancer.rds"))     # 03: same scores as Table 3.1
surv_all                 <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "surv_all.rds"))                  # 03: per-dimension Cox
clin_vars_by_cancer      <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "clin_vars_by_cancer.rds"))       # 03: Age / Stage / Grade

# Models keyed by version ("corrected", "raw") and cancer; file names are mofa_<CANCER>_<version>.hdf5
mofa_files <- list.files(mofa_dir, pattern = "^mofa_.*\\.hdf5$", full.names = TRUE)
models <- list(corrected = list(), raw = list())
for (f in mofa_files) {
  parts <- strsplit(sub("\\.hdf5$", "", basename(f)), "_")[[1]]
  models[[parts[3]]][[parts[2]]] <- suppressWarnings(load_model(f))
}

mofa_cancers <- names(models$corrected)
if (length(mofa_cancers) == 0) stop("No corrected MOFA models in ", mofa_dir, "; run 04 first")
n_cancers <- length(mofa_cancers)
cat("Corrected models:", paste(mofa_cancers, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Raw models:", paste(names(models$raw), collapse = ", "), "\n")

min_embed_var <- 1   # % embedding variance a factor must explain to enter Table 5.1
set.seed(42)
```

```{r style}
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
```

## Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Factor scores (one column per factor) + site, survival and the 03 clinical covariates.
# Joined on the metadata rownames, the same patient key 04 used to build the model.
factor_df <- function(model, cc) {
  meta <- meta_corrected_by_cancer[[cc]]
  meta_slim <- data.frame(sample   = rownames(meta),
                          TSS.Code = as.character(meta$TSS.Code),
                          time     = meta$time,
                          event    = meta$event,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  df <- get_factors(model, factors = "all", as.data.frame = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(factor), sample = as.character(sample)) %>%
    select(sample, factor, value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = factor, values_from = value) %>%          # one column per factor
    left_join(meta_slim, by = "sample")

  cv <- clin_vars_by_cancer[[cc]]                                      # Age / Stage / Grade, may be NULL
  if (!is.null(cv)) df <- left_join(df, rownames_to_column(cv, "sample"), by = "sample")
  df$TSS <- df$TSS.Code
  df
}

# Adjusted R2 of each factor on each variable (adjusted: TSS has many levels)
factor_r2 <- function(df, vars) {
  fcols <- grep("^Factor", names(df), value = TRUE)
  bind_rows(lapply(vars, function(v) {
    if (!v %in% names(df)) return(NULL)
    bind_rows(lapply(fcols, function(f) {
      y <- df[[f]]; x <- df[[v]]
      ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(x)
      if (sum(ok) < 10 || length(unique(x[ok])) < 2) return(NULL)
      fit <- lm(y[ok] ~ x[ok])
      data.frame(Factor = f, Variable = v,
                 adjR2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,
                 P = anova(fit)[1, "Pr(>F)"])
    }))
  }))
}

factor_num <- function(f) as.numeric(gsub("\\D", "", f))
short_f    <- function(f) sub("Factor", "F", f)
f_levels   <- function(f, prefix = "F") paste0(prefix, sort(unique(factor_num(f))))

# "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB" -> "TNFA Signaling Via NFKB" (identical to 03)
clean_pw <- function(x) {
  caps <- c("DNA", "UV", "MYC", "E2F", "G2M", "TNFA", "NFKB", "IL2", "STAT5", "IL6",
            "JAK", "STAT3", "KRAS", "MTORC1", "PI3K", "AKT", "MTOR", "TGF", "WNT",
            "P53", "UP", "DN", "V1", "V2")
  words <- strsplit(gsub("_", " ", sub("^HALLMARK_", "", x)), " ")
  vapply(words, function(w)
    paste(ifelse(w %in% caps, w, paste0(substr(w, 1, 1), tolower(substring(w, 2)))),
          collapse = " "), character(1))
}

# Row order from hierarchical clustering of a long table
cluster_order <- function(df, row, col, val) {
  m <- df %>%
    select(all_of(c(row, col, val))) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = all_of(col), values_from = all_of(val), values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames(row) %>% as.matrix()
  if (nrow(m) < 3) return(rownames(m))
  rownames(m)[hclust(dist(m))$order]
}

fmt_p  <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "-", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
fmt_hr <- function(hr, lo, hi)
  ifelse(is.na(hr), "-", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f\u2013%.2f)", hr, lo, hi))

# Consistent gt styling for all tables
style_gt <- function(tbl) {
  tbl %>%
    tab_options(table.font.size = 11,
                heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
                column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
                row_group.font.weight = "bold",
                data_row.padding = px(3),
                heading.align = "left")
}

fdf_list <- lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) factor_df(models$corrected[[cc]], cc))
names(fdf_list) <- mofa_cancers
```

# Main results

## Figure 5.1 Variance explained

**Purpose:** shows what each factor captures. **How to read:** in panel A, a
factor with variance in both the Embedding column and a molecular column is a
shared image-molecular axis; these are the factors interpreted in Table 5.1. A
factor active only in Embedding is morphology the omics do not capture. Panel B
shows how much of each view the model explains overall.

```{r varexp_compute}
varexp <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  get_variance_explained(models$corrected[[cc]])$r2_per_factor[[1]] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("Factor") %>% mutate(Cancer = cc)
}))

varexp_long <- varexp %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Factor, Cancer), names_to = "View", values_to = "R2") %>%
  mutate(View = factor(View, levels = intersect(view_levels, unique(View))),
         Factor_lab = factor(short_f(Factor), levels = rev(f_levels(Factor))))

r2_total <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  r2 <- get_variance_explained(models$corrected[[cc]])$r2_total[[1]]
  data.frame(Cancer = cc, View = names(r2), R2 = as.numeric(r2))
})) %>%
  mutate(View = factor(View, levels = intersect(view_levels, unique(View))))
```

```{r fig5_1, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
p_a <- ggplot(varexp_long, aes(View, Factor_lab, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(R2 >= 1, sprintf("%.0f", R2), "")), size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cancer, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#08306b", name = "Variance explained (%)") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

p_b <- ggplot(r2_total, aes(View, R2, fill = View)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cancer, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = view_cols, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Total variance\nexplained (%)") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

fig5_1 <- (p_a / p_b) + plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Figure 5.1 Variance decomposition of MOFA models (corrected embeddings)",
                  tag_levels = "A")
fig5_1
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig5_1_variance_explained.pdf"), fig5_1, width = 11, height = 7)
```

## Figure 5.2 Factors and overall survival

**Purpose:** tests which factors predict survival. **How to read:** a factor
whose CI excludes 1 in both models is prognostic independently of age, stage
and grade. If the multivariable HR moves towards 1, the factor's prognostic
signal overlaps with clinical stage. Covariates are the same as in 03
(Table 3.3), so the two analyses are directly comparable. Full numbers are in
Table S5.1.

```{r surv_prep}
surv_list <- lapply(fdf_list, function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(os_time  = as.numeric(as.character(time)),     # safe if stored as factor
           os_event = as.integer(as.character(event))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), os_time > 0)   # same definition as 01 and 03
})
```

```{r cox}
run_cox_univar <- function(surv_df, cancer_label = "") {
  factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", names(surv_df), value = TRUE)
  map_dfr(factor_cols, function(f) {
    df  <- surv_df %>% select(os_time, os_event, score = all_of(f)) %>% filter(!is.na(score))
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ scale(score), data = df),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(Factor = f, Cancer = cancer_label)
  }) %>%
    select(Cancer, Factor, HR = estimate, CI_lo = conf.low, CI_hi = conf.high, p.value) %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
}

run_cox_multivar <- function(surv_df, cancer_label = "", covariates = NULL) {
  factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", names(surv_df), value = TRUE)

  # Keep covariates with enough data and variation
  covariates <- covariates %>%
    intersect(names(surv_df)) %>%
    Filter(function(v) {
      x <- surv_df[[v]]
      sum(!is.na(x)) >= 20 && length(unique(na.omit(x))) >= 2
    }, .)
  message(cancer_label, " covariates: ", paste(covariates, collapse = ", "))

  map_dfr(factor_cols, function(f) {
    df <- surv_df %>%
      select(os_time, os_event, score = all_of(f), any_of(covariates)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(score)) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
    df <- df[complete.cases(df), ]
    if (nrow(df) < 20) return(NULL)

    cov_str <- if (length(covariates) > 0) paste("+", paste(covariates, collapse = " + ")) else ""
    fit <- tryCatch(coxph(as.formula(paste0("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ scale(score)", cov_str)),
                          data = df), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

    tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term == "scale(score)") %>%
      mutate(Factor = f, Cancer = cancer_label, n_used = nrow(df))
  }) %>%
    select(Cancer, Factor, n_used, HR = estimate, CI_lo = conf.low, CI_hi = conf.high, p.value) %>%
    mutate(fdr = p.adjust(p.value, method = "BH"))
}

cox_uni <- bind_rows(lapply(names(surv_list), function(cc)
  run_cox_univar(surv_list[[cc]], cc)))
cox_mv  <- bind_rows(lapply(names(surv_list), function(cc)
  run_cox_multivar(surv_list[[cc]], cc, c("Age", "Stage", "Grade"))))
```

```{r fig5_2, fig.width=11, fig.height=6}
forest_df <- bind_rows(
  cox_uni %>% mutate(Model = "Univariable"),
  cox_mv  %>% select(-n_used) %>% mutate(Model = "Multivariable")
) %>%
  mutate(Factor_lab = fct_reorder(short_f(Factor), factor_num(Factor), .desc = TRUE),
         Model = factor(Model, levels = c("Univariable", "Multivariable")))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.6)

fig5_2 <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(Factor_lab, HR, colour = Model, shape = Model)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = CI_lo, ymax = CI_hi), width = 0, linewidth = 0.6,
                position = dodge) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = dodge) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Cancer, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Univariable = "#2980b9", Multivariable = "#c0392b")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(Univariable = 16, Multivariable = 17)) +
  labs(title = "Figure 5.2 MOFA factors and overall survival",
       x = NULL, y = "Hazard ratio per 1 SD (95% CI, log scale)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL)

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig5_2_forest.pdf"), fig5_2, width = 11, height = 6)
```

## Figure 5.3 Factors and Hallmark pathways

**Purpose:** names the biology of each factor. **How to read:** red means the
pathway is more active in patients with high scores on that factor. GSVA
scores are the same as in 03, so factor pathways can be compared directly with
the dimension pathways in Table 3.1.

```{r gsva_compute}
gsva_cor <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  sc <- gsva_scores_by_cancer[[cc]]
  if (is.null(sc)) return(NULL)
  fmat <- get_factors(models$corrected[[cc]], factors = "all")[[1]]   # patients x factors

  # 03 saves scores as patients x pathways; transpose if they arrive the other way
  if (sum(rownames(fmat) %in% colnames(sc)) > sum(rownames(fmat) %in% rownames(sc)))
    sc <- t(as.matrix(sc))

  common <- intersect(rownames(fmat), rownames(sc))
  if (length(common) < 20) return(NULL)

  cor(fmat[common, , drop = FALSE], sc[common, , drop = FALSE],
      method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("Factor") %>%
    pivot_longer(-Factor, names_to = "Pathway", values_to = "r") %>%
    mutate(Cancer = cc, n = length(common))
})) %>%
  # P from the t approximation for Spearman r (same as 03); FDR within cancer type
  mutate(t = r * sqrt((n - 2) / pmax(1 - r^2, 1e-12)),
         P = 2 * pt(-abs(t), df = n - 2)) %>%
  group_by(Cancer) %>% mutate(FDR = p.adjust(P, method = "BH")) %>% ungroup()
```

```{r fig5_3, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
top_pw <- gsva_cor %>% group_by(Pathway) %>% summarise(mx = max(abs(r))) %>%
  slice_max(mx, n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(Pathway)

gsva_plot <- gsva_cor %>%
  filter(Pathway %in% top_pw) %>%
  mutate(Col = paste(Cancer, Factor))
pw_order <- cluster_order(gsva_plot, "Pathway", "Col", "r")

gsva_plot <- gsva_plot %>%
  mutate(Pathway_lab = factor(clean_pw(Pathway), levels = clean_pw(pw_order)),
         Factor_lab  = factor(short_f(Factor), levels = f_levels(Factor)),
         star = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", ""))

lim <- max(abs(gsva_plot$r))
fig5_3 <- ggplot(gsva_plot, aes(Factor_lab, Pathway_lab, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 3, vjust = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Cancer, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  div_fill(lim, "Spearman r") +
  labs(title = "Figure 5.3 MOFA factors and GSVA Hallmark pathways (20 strongest; * FDR < 0.05)",
       x = "MOFA factor", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))

fig5_3
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Fig5_3_GSVA_correlation.pdf"), fig5_3, width = 11, height = 7)
```

## Table 5.1 Integrated interpretation of image-associated factors

**Purpose:** one row per factor that explains at least 1% of embedding
variance, bringing every result together. **How to read** left to right: how
much image and RNA variance the factor shares; which embedding dimensions
drive it († = also prognostic in Table 3.1); which pathways it reflects (GSVA
and GSEA should agree in direction); and whether it predicts survival,
unadjusted and adjusted. A factor with † dimensions, consistent pathways and a
significant adjusted HR is the strongest integrated finding.

```{r characterise}
# Embedding weights, all factors
embed_w <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  get_weights(models$corrected[[cc]], views = "Embedding",
              factors = "all", as.data.frame = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(Cancer = cc, factor = as.character(factor),
           feature = as.character(feature), abs_weight = abs(value))
}))

# Dimensions significant in the embedding-level analysis (03: corrected, FDR < 0.05)
surv_keys <- surv_all %>%
  filter(Correction == "ComBat", !is.na(FDR), FDR < 0.05) %>%
  transmute(key = paste(Cancer, Feature)) %>%
  pull(key)

embed_top <- embed_w %>%
  group_by(Cancer, factor) %>%
  slice_max(abs_weight, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(In_03 = paste(Cancer, feature) %in% surv_keys)

# GSEA on RNA weights (ranked lists are the top-variance genes selected in 04)
pathways_hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)

gsea_res <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  m <- models$corrected[[cc]]
  if (!"RNA" %in% views_names(m)) return(NULL)
  w <- get_weights(m, views = "RNA", factors = "all", as.data.frame = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(factor = as.character(factor), feature = as.character(feature))

  bind_rows(lapply(unique(w$factor), function(f) {
    fw    <- w[w$factor == f, ]
    ranks <- sort(setNames(fw$value, fw$feature), decreasing = TRUE)
    set.seed(42)
    as.data.frame(suppressWarnings(fgsea(pathways_hallmark, ranks,
                                         minSize = 15, maxSize = 500))) %>%
      select(pathway, pval, padj, NES, size) %>%
      mutate(Factor = f, Cancer = cc)
  }))
}))
```

```{r summary_build}
top_dims <- embed_top %>%
  group_by(Cancer, factor) %>%
  slice_max(abs_weight, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(Top_dims = paste0(sub("slide_feat_", "", feature),
                              ifelse(In_03, "\u2020", ""), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(Factor = factor)

empty_join <- function(col) tibble(Cancer = character(), Factor = character(), !!col := character())

top_gsva <- if (nrow(gsva_cor) > 0) {
  gsva_cor %>% filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(Cancer, Factor) %>% slice_max(abs(r), n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(GSVA = paste0(clean_pw(Pathway), " (", sprintf("%+.2f", r), ")",
                            collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
} else empty_join("GSVA")

top_gsea <- if (nrow(gsea_res) > 0) {
  gsea_res %>% filter(padj < 0.05) %>%
    group_by(Cancer, Factor) %>% slice_min(padj, n = 2, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(GSEA = paste0(clean_pw(pathway), " (", sprintf("%+.1f", NES), ")",
                            collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop")
} else empty_join("GSEA")

factor_summary <- varexp %>%
  select(Cancer, Factor, any_of(c("Embedding", "RNA"))) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("VarExp_", .x), any_of(c("Embedding", "RNA")))
for (v in c("VarExp_Embedding", "VarExp_RNA"))
  if (!v %in% names(factor_summary)) factor_summary[[v]] <- NA_real_

factor_summary <- factor_summary %>%
  left_join(top_dims, by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  left_join(top_gsva, by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  left_join(top_gsea, by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  left_join(cox_uni %>% select(Cancer, Factor, HR, CI_lo, CI_hi, fdr),
            by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  left_join(cox_mv %>% select(Cancer, Factor, HR_adj = HR, lo_adj = CI_lo,
                              hi_adj = CI_hi, fdr_adj = fdr),
            by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  arrange(Cancer, factor_num(Factor))

write_xlsx(factor_summary, file.path(tab_dir, "Table5_1_factor_summary_full.xlsx"))
```

```{r table5_1}
tbl5_1 <- factor_summary %>%
  filter(VarExp_Embedding >= min_embed_var) %>%
  mutate(`HR (95% CI)`     = fmt_hr(HR, CI_lo, CI_hi),
         FDR_txt           = fmt_p(fdr),
         `Adj HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(HR_adj, lo_adj, hi_adj),
         FDR_adj_txt       = fmt_p(fdr_adj)) %>%
  select(Cancer, Factor, VarExp_Embedding, VarExp_RNA, Top_dims, GSVA, GSEA,
         `HR (95% CI)`, FDR_txt, `Adj HR (95% CI)`, FDR_adj_txt, fdr, fdr_adj) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Cancer") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table 5.1 Interpretation of image-associated MOFA factors",
             subtitle = paste0("Factors explaining \u2265 ", min_embed_var,
                               "% of embedding variance")) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Variance explained (%)", columns = c(VarExp_Embedding, VarExp_RNA)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Biological interpretation", columns = c(Top_dims, GSVA, GSEA)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Overall survival",
              columns = c(`HR (95% CI)`, FDR_txt, `Adj HR (95% CI)`, FDR_adj_txt)) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(VarExp_Embedding, VarExp_RNA), decimals = 1) %>%
  cols_label(VarExp_Embedding = "Embedding", VarExp_RNA = "RNA",
             Top_dims = "Top embedding dimensions",
             GSVA = "GSVA pathways (r)", GSEA = "GSEA pathways (NES)",
             FDR_txt = "FDR", FDR_adj_txt = "Adj FDR") %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "\u2013") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = c(`HR (95% CI)`, FDR_txt),
                                   rows = !is.na(fdr) & fdr < 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = c(`Adj HR (95% CI)`, FDR_adj_txt),
                                   rows = !is.na(fdr_adj) & fdr_adj < 0.05)) %>%
  cols_hide(c(fdr, fdr_adj)) %>%
  cols_width(Top_dims ~ px(140), GSVA ~ px(230), GSEA ~ px(230)) %>%
  tab_footnote("\u2020 Dimension also associated with survival in the embedding-level analysis (Table 3.1).") %>%
  tab_footnote(paste("GSVA and GSEA: two strongest Hallmark associations with FDR < 0.05.",
                     "HR per 1 SD of factor score; adjusted for age, stage and grade where available;",
                     "bold, FDR < 0.05.")) %>%
  style_gt()

gtsave(tbl5_1, file.path(tab_dir, "Table5_1_factor_summary.html"))
tbl5_1
```

# Supplementary analyses

## Table S5.1 Full Cox results

**Purpose:** the numbers behind Figure 5.2, for every factor.

```{r tableS5_1}
cox_table <- cox_uni %>%
  left_join(cox_mv %>% select(Cancer, Factor, n_used,
                              HR_adj = HR, lo_adj = CI_lo, hi_adj = CI_hi, fdr_adj = fdr),
            by = c("Cancer", "Factor")) %>%
  arrange(Cancer, factor_num(Factor)) %>%
  mutate(`HR (95% CI)`          = fmt_hr(HR, CI_lo, CI_hi),
         P                      = fmt_p(p.value),
         FDR                    = fmt_p(fdr),
         `Adjusted HR (95% CI)` = fmt_hr(HR_adj, lo_adj, hi_adj),
         `Adjusted FDR`         = fmt_p(fdr_adj),
         n_adj = ifelse(is.na(n_used), "-", as.character(n_used)))

tblS5_1 <- cox_table %>%
  select(Cancer, Factor, `HR (95% CI)`, P, FDR, n_adj,
         `Adjusted HR (95% CI)`, `Adjusted FDR`, fdr, fdr_adj) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Cancer") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Table S5.1 MOFA factors and overall survival",
             subtitle = "Cox proportional hazards; HR per 1 SD of factor score") %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Univariable", columns = c(`HR (95% CI)`, P, FDR)) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Multivariable", columns = c(n_adj, `Adjusted HR (95% CI)`, `Adjusted FDR`)) %>%
  cols_label(n_adj = "n", `Adjusted HR (95% CI)` = "HR (95% CI)", `Adjusted FDR` = "FDR") %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = c(`HR (95% CI)`, FDR), rows = fdr < 0.05)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = cells_body(columns = c(`Adjusted HR (95% CI)`, `Adjusted FDR`),
                                   rows = !is.na(fdr_adj) & fdr_adj < 0.05)) %>%
  cols_hide(c(fdr, fdr_adj)) %>%
  tab_footnote("Multivariable models adjusted for age, stage and grade where available (same covariates as Table 3.3). Bold: FDR < 0.05 (Benjamini-Hochberg within cancer type).") %>%
  style_gt()

gtsave(tblS5_1, file.path(tab_dir, "TableS5_1_cox.html"))
tblS5_1
```

## Figure S5.1 Kaplan-Meier curves for the top factor

**Purpose:** a visual of the strongest factor-survival association in each
cancer. **How to read:** the factor shown is the one with the smallest
univariable P, so the log-rank P is descriptive, not a confirmatory test. Use
Figure 5.2 and Table S5.1 for inference.

```{r figS5_1, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
km_plots <- list()
for (cc in names(surv_list)) {
  top <- cox_uni %>% filter(Cancer == cc) %>% slice_min(p.value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  if (nrow(top) == 0) next

  d <- surv_list[[cc]]
  d$Group <- factor(ifelse(d[[top$Factor]] > median(d[[top$Factor]], na.rm = TRUE),
                           "High", "Low"), levels = c("High", "Low"))
  fit <- survfit(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ Group, data = d)

  km_plots[[cc]] <- ggsurvplot(
    fit, data = d, pval = TRUE, pval.size = 3.5,
    risk.table = TRUE, risk.table.height = 0.25, fontsize = 3,
    palette = c("#c0392b", "#2980b9"), legend.labs = c("High", "Low"),
    legend.title = paste0(top$Factor, ":"),
    title = paste0(cc, " \u2013 ", top$Factor,
                   " (HR ", sprintf("%.2f", top$HR), ", FDR ", fmt_p(top$fdr), ")"),
    xlab = "Days", ylab = "Overall survival",
    ggtheme = theme_pub(), tables.theme = theme_cleantable()
  )
}

km_arr <- arrange_ggsurvplots(km_plots, print = TRUE,
                              ncol = min(3, length(km_plots)),
                              nrow = ceiling(length(km_plots) / 3))
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS5_1_KM_top_factors.pdf"), km_arr, width = 12, height = 8)
```

## Figure S5.2 and Table S5.2 Batch-correction check

**Purpose:** checks that site correction carries through to the integrated
model. **How to read:** lower site R2 for Corrected than Raw factors means the
correction propagates. Molecular views are identical in both models, so any
remaining site association comes from the omics, not the image. Factors from
separately fitted models do not correspond one-to-one, so distributions are
compared, not individual factors.

```{r tss_compute}
raw_cancers <- intersect(mofa_cancers, names(models$raw))

r2_tss <- bind_rows(lapply(raw_cancers, function(cc) {
  bind_rows(lapply(c("corrected", "raw"), function(ver) {
    df <- factor_df(models[[ver]][[cc]], cc)
    factor_r2(df, "TSS") %>% mutate(Cancer = cc, Version = ver)
  }))
})) %>%
  mutate(Version = factor(Version, levels = c("raw", "corrected"),
                          labels = c("Raw", "Corrected")))
```

```{r figS5_2, fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
if (nrow(r2_tss) > 0) {
  figS5_2 <- ggplot(r2_tss, aes(Version, adjR2, fill = Version)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(aes(colour = Version), width = 0.12, size = 1.6) +
    facet_wrap(~ Cancer, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Raw = "#c0392b", Corrected = "#2980b9"), guide = "none") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(Raw = "#c0392b", Corrected = "#2980b9"), guide = "none") +
    labs(title = "Figure S5.2 Site association of MOFA factors, raw vs corrected embeddings",
         x = NULL, y = expression(Adjusted~R^2~"(tissue source site)"))
  figS5_2
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS5_2_TSS_raw_vs_corrected.pdf"), figS5_2, width = 10, height = 4)
} else cat("No raw-embedding models available.\n")
```

```{r tableS5_2}
if (nrow(r2_tss) > 0) {
  tblS5_2 <- r2_tss %>%
    group_by(Cancer, Version) %>%
    summarise(Factors = n(), Max = max(adjR2), Median = median(adjR2),
              Sig = sum(P < 0.05), .groups = "drop") %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "Cancer") %>%
    tab_header(title = "Table S5.2 Site association of MOFA factors, raw vs corrected embeddings") %>%
    fmt_number(columns = c(Max, Median), decimals = 3) %>%
    cols_label(Max = "Max adj. R\u00b2", Median = "Median adj. R\u00b2",
               Sig = "Factors with P < 0.05") %>%
    tab_footnote("Only the embedding view is batch-corrected; molecular views are identical in both models.") %>%
    style_gt()
  gtsave(tblS5_2, file.path(tab_dir, "TableS5_2_TSS_check.html"))
  tblS5_2
}
```

## Figure S5.3 Clinical associations

**Purpose:** shows whether factors track clinical variables. **How to read:**
a factor associated with stage or grade explains why its adjusted HR in
Figure 5.2 moves towards 1. Age is median-imputed for missing values, so its
R2 is slightly conservative.

```{r figS5_3, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.5}
var_labels <- c(TSS = "Tissue source site", Age = "Age", Stage = "Stage", Grade = "Grade")

r2_clin <- bind_rows(lapply(mofa_cancers, function(cc) {
  df <- fdf_list[[cc]] %>%                                   # "Missing" is a Cox level, not data
    mutate(across(any_of(c("Stage", "Grade")), ~ na_if(as.character(.x), "Missing")))
  factor_r2(df, names(var_labels)) %>% mutate(Cancer = cc)
})) %>%
  mutate(Variable   = factor(var_labels[Variable], levels = rev(var_labels)),
         Factor_lab = factor(short_f(Factor), levels = f_levels(Factor)),
         R2_plot    = pmax(adjR2, 0),
         star       = ifelse(P < 0.05, "*", ""))

figS5_3 <- ggplot(r2_clin, aes(Factor_lab, Variable, fill = R2_plot)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 3, vjust = 0.75) +
  facet_grid(. ~ Cancer, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#08306b", name = expression(Adjusted~R^2)) +
  labs(title = "Figure S5.3 MOFA factors and clinical variables (* P < 0.05)",
       x = "MOFA factor", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))

figS5_3
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS5_3_clinical_associations.pdf"), figS5_3, width = 11, height = 4.5)
```

## Figure S5.4 Embedding dimensions driving each factor

**Purpose:** links factors back to individual embedding dimensions.
**How to read:** dimensions marked † were prognostic on their own in 03; they
are the bridge between the per-dimension analysis and the MOFA factors.

```{r figS5_4, fig.width=11, fig.height=2.6 * n_cancers}
dims_show <- embed_top %>%
  group_by(Cancer, factor) %>% slice_max(abs_weight, n = 5, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% distinct(Cancer, feature, In_03)

embed_plot <- embed_w %>%
  inner_join(dims_show, by = c("Cancer", "feature")) %>%
  mutate(Dim = paste0(sub("slide_feat_", "", feature), ifelse(In_03, "\u2020", "")),
         Factor_lab = factor(short_f(factor), levels = rev(f_levels(factor))))

lim <- max(abs(embed_plot$value))
figS5_4 <- ggplot(embed_plot, aes(Dim, Factor_lab, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ Cancer, ncol = 1, scales = "free") +
  div_fill(lim, "MOFA weight") +
  labs(title = "Figure S5.4 Embedding weights of each factor (top 5 dimensions per factor)",
       x = "Embedding dimension", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

figS5_4
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS5_4_embedding_weights.pdf"), figS5_4,
       width = 11, height = 2.6 * n_cancers)
```

## Figure S5.5 GSEA on RNA factor weights

**Purpose:** an independent check of Figure 5.3. GSVA correlates patient-level
pathway scores with factor scores, while GSEA tests the genes the factor loads
on. **How to read:** pathways significant in both, with the same direction,
are the most robust factor interpretations. The ranked list contains only the
5,000 most variable genes kept in 04, so gene sets made up mostly of
low-variance genes cannot reach significance.

```{r figS5_5, fig.width=11, fig.height=7}
if (nrow(gsea_res) > 0) {
  top_gsea_pw <- gsea_res %>% group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(best = min(padj, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    filter(best < 0.05) %>% slice_min(best, n = 25, with_ties = FALSE) %>% pull(pathway)

  gsea_plot <- gsea_res %>%
    filter(pathway %in% top_gsea_pw) %>%
    mutate(Col = paste(Cancer, Factor))
  gsea_order <- cluster_order(gsea_plot, "pathway", "Col", "NES")

  gsea_plot <- gsea_plot %>%
    mutate(Pathway_lab = factor(clean_pw(pathway), levels = clean_pw(gsea_order)),
           Factor_lab  = factor(short_f(Factor), levels = f_levels(Factor)),
           star = ifelse(!is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05, "*", ""))

  lim <- max(abs(gsea_plot$NES), na.rm = TRUE)
  figS5_5 <- ggplot(gsea_plot, aes(Factor_lab, Pathway_lab, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = star), size = 3, vjust = 0.75) +
    facet_grid(. ~ Cancer, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    div_fill(lim, "NES") +
    labs(title = "Figure S5.5 Hallmark GSEA of RNA factor weights (* FDR < 0.05)",
         x = "MOFA factor", y = NULL) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))

  figS5_5
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "FigS5_5_GSEA.pdf"), figS5_5, width = 11, height = 7)
} else cat("No GSEA results (no RNA view in any model).\n")
```
